hooks.description: Validate plugin file frontmatter conventions (agents use tools:, commands use allowed-tools:)

hooks.prompt: Context: $ARGUMENTS. FIRST: Determine if you are currently operating as a PLUGIN BUILDER (creating or modifying Claude Code plugins). If you are NOT in a plugin builder role (e.g. you are an other system agents), respond {"ok": true} immediately — this plugin structure check only applies to plugin builder sessions. If you ARE the plugin builder, proceed: A file was just written or edited. Check the tool result for the file path. ONLY check files inside a plugin build directory (/tmp/claude-kit-build-*/) whose path contains agents/*.md, commands/*.md, or skills/*/*.md. For ALL other files (specs, docs, phases, configs, scripts, any file not matching those three plugin subdirectory patterns) respond with a single word: ok. For matching plugin files: verify real substantive content exists — not just headers, TODOs, or placeholder text. If fewer than 20 lines of actual content, respond: WARN: <filename> appears to be a skeleton with insufficient content. Otherwise respond: ok
